# Sacred Stone Headstone Cleaning
# Place this file at your domain root (e.g. https://sacredheadstonecare.com/llms.txt)
# Replace "https://sacredheadstonecare.com" below with your real domain once live.

> Sacred Stone Headstone Cleaning provides professional headstone and grave marker cleaning across Utah County, Utah, offered as one-time visits or recurring subscriptions (quarterly, semi-annual, or annual). All cleaning uses stone-safe, non-abrasive, non-acidic methods appropriate to granite, marble, and bronze markers. Based in Provo, Utah, serving families locally and those who live out of state.

## Services
- [Homepage](https://sacredheadstonecare.com/): Overview of services, plans, pricing, and coverage area.
- [Plans & Pricing](https://sacredheadstonecare.com/#plans): One-time cleaning and quarterly/semi-annual/annual subscription pricing.
- [Coverage Area](https://sacredheadstonecare.com/#coverage): Cemeteries served across Utah County, including Provo, Orem, Springville, and American Fork.
